goal: PHP review: input handling, SQL, file inclusion, session settings and type declarations.
use: PHP review: input handling, SQL, file inclusion, session settings and type declarations. Use when asked to review a PHP project or module.

steps.note: Read the project setup. Composer file, PHP version and configuration.
Check input. Flag superglobals used without validation.
Check SQL. Flag queries built with concatenation or interpolation.
Check file inclusion. Flag include or require with input-derived paths.
Report. Each finding with file and line, severity and the fix.
